result.summary: Mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files containing assertions. It also updates CI lint setup to allow `clang-format` execution within scripted diffs and sorts the updated includes.
result.problem: Assertions in test code frequently rely on transitive includes or standard `<cassert>`, creating ambiguity over whether assertions can be disabled by `NDEBUG`. The codebase also encounters compilation failures when assertions in `util/check.h` are disabled or configured differently, and missing direct includes impedes Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling.
evidence: PR description: 'The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions.'
PR description: 'The changes here will also make it easier to run IWYU.'
result.scope_notes: A large mechanical scripted diff spanning 153 test/bench files along with a small modification to `ci/lint/01_install.sh` allowing `clang-format` in scripted diff checks.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased onto newer master branch, retaining the same three-commit structure and scripted approach.
result.card: This PR mechanically adds explicit `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across test, fuzz, and benchmark files. It resolves ambiguity around whether `NDEBUG` disables assertions, avoids compile errors when assertions are configured differently, and assists Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling. A minor CI lint change also allows `clang-format` inside scripted-diff verification to resort includes. The change is restricted to test code and lint tooling.

risk.why: Modifications are restricted to include directives in test files and CI lint scripts; a bug would only cause compile or linter failures.
